title: Adaptation and Pilot Testing of a Lung Cancer Screening Decision Aid for Patients From a Safety-Net Healthcare System
official: Adaptation and Pilot Testing of a Lung Cancer Screening Decision Aid for Patients From a Safety-Net Healthcare System
summary: The goal of the study is to adapt and test a participant decision aid about lung cancer screening for use with patients in theHarris Health System (HHS).

interventions.name: Lung cancer screening decision aid video

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. 50-80 years of age
2. Current smokers or smokers who have quit less than 15 years ago
3. Speak either English or Spanish
4. No history of lung cancer
5. Family member of someone with a history of smoking AND lung cancer

Exclusion Criteria:

sites.f: The University of Texas M. D. Anderson Cancer Center
